Kangaroo Bus Lines an industry leader in the Queensland travel and tourism sector. With an iconic brand Australia wide, pristine busses and friendly, passionate staff there is no doubt as to why the last 40+ years have seen them grow from strength to strength.

40 Year Anniversary Video.

This video, along with many others created by Pepper Productions, showcases many of their stakeholders and the growth of the company and was created to celebrate their 40-year anniversary. Pepper Productions are proud to be a part of such an exceptional and inspirational company.

Birdsville Races Video.

Pepper Productions where lucky to join Kangaroo Bus Lines to take footage of and experience their annual trip to Birdsville Races. This trip allows everyone on board to fully appreciate our spectacular Australian landscape on this stunning tour to the Simpson Desert. Kangaroo Bus Lines selflessly support the Royal Flying Doctors offering services from camp to the races throughout the 5-day trip.
